reviews.review:
[h1]Alien Swarm is a pretty awesome game[/h1] - to put it lightly, and it's another one of Valves masterpieces (excluding the big failure that Artifact is).

[h1]How it started[/h1]
This is a top-down, co-op, sci-fi shooter with tactical elements. It was originally Unreal Tournament 2004 mod, later bought by Valve. It was released for free as an experiment to see how would the community utilize the SDK tools it offers, such as creating your own weapons, maps, etc.

[h1]Story and Gameplay[/h1]

[*]In Alien Swarm You are a team of four marines, send to a colony base, tasked with finding possible survivors and exterminating the aliens, that have swarmed the base. 
The four character classes include: tech, medic, officer and special weapon class) each with their specialties, providing different buffs to the team, such as the Tech's hacking ability or the  Medic's healing tools etc.

[*]Visually, the game looks great, even after twelve years. Gameplay is an absolute fun and the atmosphere that is created from game pace, music, visuals and the story is something you might not want to miss. 

[*]The only downside is that it doesn't have single player. Your only single player option is by using the developer console for which you can find guides in the game's community.

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]
In other words, if you are looking for a real quality top-down, co-op, sci-fi shooter, to sink a lot of time in, and have fun with your friends - then this is for you. Also, Alien Swarm Reactive Drop adds a lot more to the game, so feel free to try that instead.
Had a lot of fun with my brother and we both enjoyed our alien swarm hat for TF2.
